name: Control Center
author: culcat
description: macOS-inspired Control Center panel with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, VPN, sound, display, power and media controls, styled with Omarchy's native theme.

barWidget.description: A macOS-style Bento control panel for network, Bluetooth, audio, display and power.

schema.label: Always show the media player card

schema.label: Language
schema.description: Interface language: auto, en, ru, uk, de, es, fr or zh. "auto" follows the system locale.
